title: Three Outfits
text: At my words, my father and Éclair turned their heads toward me with a movement that sounded almost like a “gigiigi.” It brings back memories. The sight of my father in all his glory, seizing the gold and treasures hoarded by those thieves. We use the money we get from that to do all sorts of things, you know.
“What!? Does Lord Iwatani actually go that far!?”
“I don’t know! I mean, what’s that supposed to mean!? What’s with this sudden revelation of barbaric acts?!”

Oh? Father suddenly seemed flustered, as if he were at a loss. I seem to recall that in situations like this, he used to display the dignified bearing of a confident ruler and simply ignore Big Sister’s warnings.
“Motoyasu-kun!”
“That’s right. Bandits are a resource! He said that by releasing them instead of killing them, we’d be able to harvest them again after a while.”
“Lord Iwatani! Are you telling me you were summoned just to do something like that?”
“What on earth is my future self getting himself into!”
Oh? It feels like the commotion is getting louder. I wonder why?
“Weren’t you just working those slaves to the bone?”
“I heard that, but letting bandits live and escape—what on earth were you doing? Didn’t those bandits cause trouble for anyone?”
“If I recall correctly… you said that even if we caught the bandits here, it would just allow other bandits to expand their territory, so the outcome wouldn’t change.”
Éclair is pressing her hand to her forehead in exasperation.

“I can’t imagine Lord Kitamura lying to Lord Iwatani. So, looking at Lord Iwatani now, I can’t help but wonder what kind of hell the future Lord Iwatani must have gone through to say such things… In fact, it’s because of our country that he’s become so twisted… I’d like to apologize for that right here.”
“Wait, are there really that many bandits—to the point of overflowing? There’s absolutely no hope!”
“It’s true—no matter how many we defeated, they just kept spawning.”

“There’s a saying from a hero of the past who fought bandits: ‘Even if the sand on the beach runs out, the seeds of thieves in this world will never run out.’… While it’s utterly disheartening, at the same time, I feel like I’ve caught a glimpse of the resilience of the future Mr. Iwatani.”
“I don’t want to go through an experience like that!”

My Father shouted, sounding somewhat flustered. Well, I can understand how he feels. Before I awakened as The Love Hunter, I only ever saw the bright side of things. To be honest, I even looked down on what my Father was doing. Seriously… I was such a foolish man—it’s enough to make me cringe.

“Wait a minute… According to Motoyasu-kun, this world is in a loop, right?　In situations like this, isn’t there supposed to be a phenomenon—like the butterfly effect or the force of history—that tries to pull things back to the original timeline?”
“Is that so? Then, Lord Iwatani, you’re about to experience hell…”
“No way… Am I going to end up homeless or get thrown out with nothing to my name?”

My father-in-law looked at the envoy from Siltvelt with a frightened expression. The butterfly effect… I’ve heard that term in some sci-fi story. Unfortunately, back then I was only interested in online games and pork, so I can’t remember the details.
“Shield Hero! No matter what happens, I absolutely won’t let that happen, so please calm down!”
“Hmm…? Naofumi, what’s wrong?”
Unable to grasp the situation, Sakura tilts her head in confusion.
“It seems that in the future, Naofumi-sama will go through a terrible ordeal and become someone who does very bad things without batting an eye.”
“Is that so? But Sakura will protect Naofumi and never abandon him, right?”
“Are you going to hunt bandits? Will they taste good?”
“No way! Don’t twist my words like that! And Kou, you absolutely must not try cannibalism, okay!”
Things are getting a bit rowdy, aren’t they? “It’s better than being gloomy, I suppose.” As I watched from a distance, my Father spoke up.
“Motoyasu, don’t act like this has nothing to do with you!”
“Wait, now that I think about it, Lord Kitamura’s actions… I can see why.”
“You mustn’t accept that! I don’t want to become a villain!”
My Father’s shout echoed through the area.
“No… I don’t want to go through that kind of experience…”
“That’s exactly why you need to get stronger, Mr. Iwatani.”
“Y-yeah, you’re right.”
After all that commotion, my Father and the others decided to set out on a hunting trip with all the Filolial-sama. Since I’m making clothes in town, I’ll be staying behind.
“Well then, have a safe trip!”
“We’re off!”
“Whoa—run a little slower—otherwise we’ll—!”
“T-the feathers are tangled in my hands! I can’t—I can’t get them out! Shield Herooooooo!”

The messengers from Éclair and Siltvelt are groaning, aren’t they? But everything takes some getting used to. By the way, today I’m once again improving Yuki-chan and the others’ attributes while lowering their levels. It’s far better than staying stuck at Level 40 without ever leveling up. It’s heartwarming to watch the Filolial-samas grow stronger day by day.
“Naofumi, let’s go—”
“Yeah…”
“It’ll be okay—no matter what happens, Sakura will protect Naofumi, okay?”
“Thank you, Sakura-chan.”
“Ehehe—”
My Father and Sakura-chan really are close, aren’t they?
“Well, I’m off then.”
“Be careful, now.”
“Yeah. I won’t just keep relying on Motoyasu-kun to protect me—I’ll do my best to protect everyone as the Shield Hero.”

My father raised his hand and set off with Sakura-chan. Well then, before leaving, I returned to my room at the inn with the Magical Power fabric I’d successfully turned into cloth from Filolial-sama. Three pieces, I see. I’ll need to think about the color scheme when dyeing them. I have plenty of dye, so I’ll make clothes that suit Yuki-chan and the others!
Before long… I suppose it’s past noon.
“They’re done!”

I’d even like to praise myself for getting it done so efficiently. The outfits that suit Yuki-chan and the others are complete. Filolial-sama all look great in dresses. However, the basic design is also important.

Since Yuki-chan has white hair, I made her a dress with a beige base. For Kou, I went with overalls—both for ease of movement and because that’s what he wanted. That navy denim-like shade will definitely suit him. Since Sakura-chan gets along well with her Father, I made her a dress in a uniform light green color.
Just imagining everyone wearing these fills me with an overwhelming sense of happiness. That said, now that everyone’s clothes are done, I have some free time. I look out the window.

Then, I caught a glimpse of people in the shadow of the building. There seem to be more than before. I have a bad feeling about this. I’ll pack Yuki-chan and the others’ clothes into a bag and put them away. I hear the sound of rustling footsteps—it seems a large crowd has gathered outside the inn.
“Spear Hero!”
The burly Demi-Humans who had been defending the inn are rushing over one after another.
“What’s the matter?”
“People who appear to be followers of the Three Heroes Church are gathering. It might be dangerous to stay here any longer.”
“Hmm…”

Just as we were talking, I sensed a high concentration of Magical Power in the area. Remembering that my Father had asked me to protect everyone, I opened the door and knocked the Demi-Human to the ground. At that very moment, massive boulders began raining down on the inn. With a deafening roar, the inn was about to collapse.
“Hmph!”
I blocked the falling megaliths with my spear.
“Ah… ah…”

The fallen Demi-Human was speechless. As far as I recall, the only people currently in this inn are the Demi-Human bodyguards and the innkeepers… This is a hassle. Still, since it’s my Father’s order, I’ll try to keep casualties to a minimum. I’ll send those megaliths flying back into the sky.
“Brionac!”

I unleashed Brionac at the boulders, reducing them to charcoal, and from the second floor of the half-destroyed inn, I glared down at the culprits. It’s safe to assume the group gathered here consists of followers of the Three Heroes Church. Given their numbers, the most likely explanation is Cooperative Magic “Megaliths.” If there are many, it’s Ceremonial Magic; if few, it’s Cooperative Magic. The power decreases accordingly.
Still… this is beyond reckless. Now that they realize they couldn’t kill me, they’ve started to flee. Criminals who suddenly cast Magic at town buildings… they have no right to live.

I have to fend off the sparks flying my way, and above all, if the work had been delayed, Yuki-chan and the others’ clothes would have been torn. I absolutely cannot forgive this! I’ll make them pay for that stupidity with their lives!
“Aiming Lancer X!”
Multi-Lokk! Targets: those fools from earlier! It seems they’re foolishly trying to blend in with the onlookers who were drawn by the commotion. But you can’t escape the Aiming Lancer that easily.
Fire! As I threw the spear, it split into multiple beams of light and pierced the three followers of the Three Heroes Church who had cast Magic at the inn.
“Aaaaaaargh!”

Screams rose from the onlookers, but no one other than the culprits was caught in the blast. I, Motoyasu, would never harm innocent bystanders. If I did something like that, I wouldn’t be able to face my father-in-law, Filo-tan, or Filolial-sama. Just as I promised Filo-tan, I’ll be sincere, kind to everyone, keep my promises, and faithfully obey my father-in-law’s orders… I’ll become The Love Hunter!
And so, all you fools who defy my father-in-law will be slaughtered. HAHAHA!
“This spear can only strike evil spirits!”
“Ah… ah… amazing… godlike strength…”
The Demi-Human bodyguards let out a gasp.
“It seems they’ve caught up to us completely. It’s going to be a real struggle to meet up with my Father and the others.”
Honestly, if my Father and the others hadn’t stopped me, I’d be on my way to kill the Pope of the Three Heroes Church—Trash and all—right this very moment.
